preprocess_images: preprocess a batch of images using BaseImageProcessor with resize, normalize, and rescale operations
select_best_resolution: select the best resolution from a list of possible resolutions based on original image size and effective pixel coverage
get_size_dict: convert size parameters to a validated dictionary with height and width keys for image preprocessing configs
validate_size_dict: validate that a size dictionary has one of the allowed key sets for image processing
get_patch_output_size: calculate the output image dimensions after cropping to a target resolution preserving aspect ratio
